subtests.name: DeviceBoundSessionRegistrationObserver fires upon session registration in secure context
DeviceBoundSessionRegistrationObserver returns existing sessions on attachment and then fires on new registrations
DeviceBoundSessionRegistrationObserver handles multiple concurrent observe() invocations gracefully
DeviceBoundSessionRegistrationObserver does not see a session scoped to another origin of the same site
DeviceBoundSessionRegistrationObserver stops after disconnect() and gets the existing sessions again after a new observe()
